look_here_first: Look for woody climbing vines with leaves divided into five separate leaflets and tendrils tipped with adhesive pads; inspect leaflets and berries to distinguish from poison ivy and grape.
photo_note: Temporary one-photo learner coverage. Keep until stronger diagnostic gallery coverage replaces or supplements it.
identification_caution: Five leaflets, not the three of poison ivy; identification should not rely exclusively on number of leaflets.

images.role: Provisional vine habit and compound five-leaflet foliage; tendril pads and dark fruits not shown clearly.
